name: slaide
description: Slaide is an AI presentation maker and slide deck generator. Create, edit and export real PowerPoint presentations, documents and Excel workbooks in your own Slaide account - from a brief, your notes or attached PDF, Word, Excel and PowerPoint files.

interface.longDescription:
Slaide is an AI presentation maker and slide deck generator. Describe your topic, paste your notes or attach a PDF, Word, Excel or PowerPoint file, and Slaide writes, designs and builds a finished, editable PowerPoint presentation for you, with your saved brand kit (logo, colors, fonts) applied if you have one.

Make the presentation you need:
- Pitch decks, sales decks and investor presentations
- Business reports, quarterly reviews and project updates from your own figures
- Training, workshop, lecture and course slides
- A slide deck from a PDF report, a Word document, an Excel sheet or plain notes

How it works: tell the assistant what the presentation is for - topic, audience, number of slides, language. Slaide can research missing facts on the web, writes every slide and lays it out in the background. Building takes a few minutes; Slaide reports progress and gives you a link to the result. Then open it in Slaide or export an editable PowerPoint (.pptx), a PDF, a Word file or a PNG. Slaide also builds Excel workbooks and Word documents from the same material.

Everything lands in your Slaide library: find a deck by name or recency, read its slides and speaker notes, change a single slide and leave the rest untouched, or export it again. Every change an assistant makes is versioned and can be undone, and you can open any presentation in Slaide to keep editing it by hand.

You sign in with your existing Slaide account. Work started from the chat follows the same account limits as working in Slaide directly. You can disconnect at any time in Slaide under Settings → Account → AI assistants — access stops immediately.
capabilities: Make a presentation from a topic, a brief or your notes - written, designed and laid out for you
Turn a PDF, Word, Excel or PowerPoint file into a finished slide deck
Export an editable PowerPoint (.pptx), PDF, Word, PNG or Excel file with a private 15-minute link
Create pitch decks, sales decks, business reports, training slides and project updates
Apply your saved brand kit (logo, colors, fonts) to every slide automatically
Research missing facts on the web while writing the slides
Find any presentation in your Slaide library by title or recency
Read the slides, speaker notes and Excel cells of a document you own
Change one slide and leave the rest of the deck exactly as it is
Build Excel workbooks and Word documents from the same material
Open any result in Slaide to keep editing by hand - every change is versioned and can be undone
defaultPrompt: Make a 10-slide presentation about remote work best practices for my team meeting.
Turn the attached PDF report into a 10-slide presentation and give me the PowerPoint file.
Create a 6-slide pitch deck for a new café concept and export it as PowerPoint.

positive.prompt: What presentations do I have in Slaide?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the demo account's decks, most recently edited first, with links.

positive.prompt: Show me what is on the slides of the Q3 Business Review deck.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises the pages of "Q3 Business Review" by page number.

positive.description: Create a deck from an attached file
positive.prompt: Turn the attached quarterly report into a 5-slide summary deck.
positive.expected_behavior: A job starts at once and the answer lists the attachment. After a few minutes the status is completed: a 5-page deck built from the PDF's content is in the library, with a link to it.

positive.prompt: In the Q3 Business Review deck, change the revenue on page 2 to 4.8 million euros. Change nothing else.
positive.expected_behavior: Only page 2 changes and the version increases. Other pages stay unchanged.

positive.prompt: Export the Q3 Business Review deck as PowerPoint.
positive.expected_behavior: A download link to a .pptx that opens in PowerPoint. The link expires after 15 minutes.

negative.prompt: Open the Slaide document with id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000.

negative.description: Buying or changing a plan is not supported
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Slaide plan to Pro and buy more credits.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell anything. It cannot buy, subscribe, upgrade or change a plan; it shows no plans or prices and links to no checkout. Everything it does happens inside the user's own Slaide account.

publication.release_notes: Listing update: new name, subtitle, description and example prompts (AI presentation maker, PowerPoint and slide deck generator). The tools and permissions are unchanged.

de-DE.subtitle: KI-Präsentationen erstellen
de-DE.description:
Slaide erstellt Präsentationen mit KI – als Präsentationsgenerator für PowerPoint und Foliensätze. Beschreibe dein Thema, füge deine Notizen ein oder hänge eine PDF-, Word-, Excel- oder PowerPoint-Datei an, und Slaide schreibt, gestaltet und baut daraus eine fertige, bearbeitbare PowerPoint-Präsentation, mit deinem gespeicherten Marken-Kit (Logo, Farben, Schriften), falls du eines hast.

Das kannst du erstellen:
- Pitch Decks, Vertriebspräsentationen und Investorenpräsentationen
- Geschäftsberichte, Quartalsreviews und Projekt-Updates aus deinen eigenen Zahlen
- Schulungs-, Workshop-, Vorlesungs- und Kursfolien
- Eine Präsentation aus einem PDF-Bericht, einem Word-Dokument, einer Excel-Tabelle oder einfachen Notizen

So funktioniert es: Sag dem Assistenten, wofür die Präsentation gedacht ist – Thema, Zielgruppe, Folienzahl, Sprache. Slaide kann fehlende Fakten im Web recherchieren, schreibt jede Folie und gestaltet sie im Hintergrund. Das Bauen dauert ein paar Minuten; Slaide meldet den Fortschritt und gibt dir einen Link zum Ergebnis. Danach öffnest du sie in Slaide oder exportierst eine bearbeitbare PowerPoint-Datei (.pptx), ein PDF, ein Word-Dokument oder ein PNG. Aus demselben Material baut Slaide auch Excel-Tabellen und Word-Dokumente.

Alles landet in deiner Slaide-Bibliothek: ein Deck nach Name oder Aktualität finden, Folien und Sprechernotizen lesen, eine einzelne Folie ändern, ohne den Rest anzufassen, oder erneut exportieren. Jede Änderung eines Assistenten ist versioniert und lässt sich rückgängig machen; in Slaide kannst du jede Präsentation von Hand weiterbearbeiten.

Du meldest dich mit deinem bestehenden Slaide-Konto an. Was aus dem Chat gestartet wird, unterliegt denselben Konto-Grenzen wie die Arbeit direkt in Slaide. Du kannst die Verbindung jederzeit in Slaide unter Einstellungen → Konto → KI-Assistenten trennen – der Zugriff endet sofort.
